section_summary.extract_value: This Results section presents descriptive statistics and bivariate correlations from what appears to be a single study examining relationships between body esteem, body orientation, body appreciation, and body-related conversations. The text reports that participants showed stronger appearance versus performance orientation, women had more positive attitudes toward body-as-process than body-as-object, and body appreciation was positively related to exercise conversations and performance orientation but negatively related to appearance orientation and weight loss/dieting conversations. Table 1 is referenced for detailed correlations but is not provided in the text excerpt.
